dedupe_keys.name: data for the traffic flow simulation in the area of alessandria in italy in case of road network disruption

description: Data for the traffic flow simulation in the area of Alessandria in Italy in case of road network disruption is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Amirehsan Charlang Bakhtyari. The input file contains supply data (based on OpenStreetMap) and demand data (from the 2011 Italian census) for the Alessandria area in Italy, detailing both basic and disrupted flood scenarios to be run in SUMO software. It includes information on closed bridges during flood events, based on OpenStreetMap data. Coverage: national (IT); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
